'''Verala Mishar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was paid to deliver supplies to the covert installation [[Whisper Base]]. She took a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the base every two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Verala Mishar is mentioned as a possible encounter in ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
